subject: Leaflet: How does "Z order" work for addLayersControl()

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Leaflet: How does "Z order" work for addLayersControl()
parts:
I have a shiny app. with a leaflet map.

The map has a circle layer which allows the user to map various data.

You can also add some polygons - the circles are much smaller than the polygons.

I have a LayersControl that lets the user chose to display the polygons or not.  

Is there some way to ensure that the circles are always on top?  The autoZIndex argment of addLayersControl() seems to address this but I have no clue how to indicate Z orders.

Does anyone understand this?

Thanks for any insight
John Paul
